page.layout: Two printed blocks on one page: one column of running text with marginal notes in the left and right margins; running head at the top, page number at the top right, gathering signature at the foot. No catchword.

main_text.p: quem duodeviginti annos regnasse significavimus, Cyrus uno & triginta annis rerum potitus est. Scythis bellum inferes, in praelio cecidit: secundo anno postquam Tarquinius superbus Romae regnare coepit. Cyro Cambyses filius ejus successit, regnavitq; annos novem. Hic cum AE.afex,Io-[?] gyptum atq; Aethiopiam bello premeretfephus.7,[?] Fuccius.8 & subegisset, victorq; in Persas revertere.alij. tur cafu scipsum vulneravit, ex eo q; ictu[?] periit. Post hujus mortem magi duob Come-tes & O-ropaftes. fratres, natione Medi, menses septem Persarum regnum obtinuerunt. Ad hos interficiendos septem nobilissimi Persae conjuraverunt; quorum princeps fuit Darius Hystaspis filius, natus ex fratre patruele Cyri, omniumq; consensu regnum ei delatum: regnavit annos sex & xxx. Hic ante quadriennium quam decederet, apud Marathonem pugnavit, celeberrimo Graecis Romanisque historiis praelio.cHerodot.[?]l.6. Thu-cydides,i. Id gestum post Romam conditam anno fere ducentesimo & sexagesimo, Mache-Iusti,3.[?] rino & Augurino consulibus: abhinc annos, si tamen investigatio Romanorum consulum non fefellit, DCCC LXXX. & VIII. page.notes: Marginal notes on the left (afex,Io-; fephus.7,; Fuccius.8; alij.; b Come-tes & O-ropaftes.) and right (Iustinus; cHerodot.; l.6. Thu-cydides,i.; Iusti,3.) were placed at their approximate positions; the notes beside "AE." and "fephus" are cut off and doubtful. "ictu" is doubtful: the print looks like "istu". "Macherino" appears printed as "Mache-rino" across a line end. The note "Iustinus" beside "terriciendos" and the note "Fuccius.8" are only partly legible. Numerals copied as printed. The Roman numerals in the last line (DCCC, LXXX., VIII.) are read as printed.
